definition.en: IFAD is a specialized agency of the United Nations and an international financial institution dedicated to eradicating poverty and hunger in rural areas of developing countries.
definition.hi: IFAD is a specialized agency of the United Nations and an international financial institution dedicated to eradicating poverty and hunger in rural areas of developing countries.

importanceInUpsc.en: IFAD is significant for UPSC GS-3 as it relates to agricultural development, food security, and international cooperation. Understanding its role helps in analyzing India's engagement with global institutions to address rural poverty and sustainable agricultural practices.
importanceInUpsc.hi: IFAD is significant for UPSC GS-3 as it relates to agricultural development, food security, and international cooperation. Understanding its role helps in analyzing India's engagement with global institutions to address rural poverty and sustainable agricultural practices.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the mandate and structure of IFAD.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the mandate and structure of IFAD.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of IFAD-funded projects on rural development in India.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the impact of IFAD-funded projects on rural development in India.
